question: A business enterprise that makes profit primarily through trade, buying goods cheap and selling them at higher prices is known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**mercantile.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A business enterprise that makes profit primarily through trade, buying goods cheap and selling them at higher prices is known as** mercantile.**
 
• **Mercantile trade **is a type of business that produces money primarily through trade, which involves buying low-cost goods and selling them for a higher price.
 
• A sort of **business called "mercantile trade" **includes **purchasing inexpensive thing**s and **reselling them for a profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mercenary:**

 
 
• A mercenary is a** soldie**r who is paid to fight by a** country or group** that they do not belong to.
 
 
 
• **Bartering:**
 
 
• Barter is a** transaction **in which **two or more parties exchange products **or services** without exchanging cash** or other forms of payment ex. credit cards.
 
 
 
• **Merchandising:**
 
 
• It refers to the **marketing and sales of products.**
